'''Surela''' is a ''[[der'sul'dam]]'' from [[Seandar]] that is with [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]] on [[Cantorin]]. 

== Activities ==
When [[Taisa]] fails to control [[Pura]] properly during an interview with Suroth, [[Alwhin]] tells her to seek out Surela to learn how to be a better ''sul'dam''.{{ref/book|4|1}}
